title: Vincent van Gogh, Cafe terrace at night, 2 dollars
descriptionPlain: Description Great gift idea for art lovers Decorated with digital printing of the highest quality Fusion of arts embraced in a silver coin Unique numismatic series Vincent van Gogh saw painting as his redemption, a method to escape the cruelties of the actual world into the vibrant world of images.
